parent_and_coparent_semantics.respondent_vs_parent: A respondent reporting a parent's habits/beliefs is NOT the parent's own response.
parent_and_coparent_semantics.household_vs_same_adult: A household-level variable is not an adult's own measured attitude.
parent_and_coparent_semantics.two_adults_vs_dyad: Two adult samples or same household label do not prove both adults were administered linked comparable items.
parent_and_coparent_semantics.possible_lawful_output: Only an originally supported distribution on the question's actual respondent/unit/role grain, with uncertainty.

first_scoped_real_minimum: After exact source and model-use grants: one original measured same-respondent position A, attitude B and target Y with P(Y|A), P(Y|A,B), valid C1/N10E generated joint, and one genuinely selected scoped N9 with declared compatible demands. Adding C is second successive condition only when original source operations support it. Independent D01/D03 may populate their needed world slots; no blanket all-35 waiting or completion claim.
